items.theme: AI trade, Nvidia leadership, market volatility, inflation, interest rates
items.title: Markets Expert Rebecca Walser Delivers Outlook for Remainder of 2026
items.verd: Fresh portfolio signal: investors are demanding evidence that AI spending is producing measurable economic value; Nvidia’s leadership news has renewed optimism but volatility remains a central risk.
items.vc: Rebecca Walser, Chief Investment Officer, Walser Wealth Management
items.body: The interview covers the AI trade, Nvidia’s leadership announcement, inflation, Federal Reserve policy, bond yields, technology stocks and the outlook for the remainder of 2026.
